questions.prompt: A hypermetropic person’s near point is 1 m. The correcting lens is…
Explain the difference between the mirror formula and the lens formula, and why the sign convention matters for both.
questions.modelAnswer: Mirror: 1/v + 1/u = 1/f; lens: 1/v − 1/u = 1/f. In both, distances are measured from the pole or optical centre using the New Cartesian sign convention (object distance negative, distances along the incident light positive). The signs tell us whether images are real or virtual, and upright or inverted; using the wrong sign gives the wrong position and nature of the image.
